falsification_tests: Any Eteocypriot analysis output exists under this spec; or the draft lacks the legal status, the held-out design, or the adjudication route.

claims.text: The Meroitic work under this spec is the scoping of a reproduction benchmark as a study spec: an independent implementation reproduces published sign-frequency and positional results from the openly published 2025 Meroitic corpus, against success criteria and a falsifier fixed in the scoping record, using the existing fixture module as its starting inventory; the benchmark's execution is a separately commissioned study, not a stage of this spec.
